authority: Full canonical EFZ PE exact original-bound codegen of 8,640-byte Scene6 options renderer in natural VC7.1 C++
method: Selected normal VC7.1 /Od /G6 /MT /Gy /W3 compile of natural C++; all 8,608 original code bytes and original eight-DWORD switch table compared after independently PE-binding every one of 105 actual COFF relocation operands. No normalized/masked/substituted code bytes, ASM, padding or full cold replay.
behavior: Settings page/background and overlay, eight original option selection highlights, configuration-value indicator sprites, record/profile view, numeric render calls, palette-based score screen, three scenes/pages and display Present.
source_findings: Only the first of the options page and record page drawing pairs use original shared source/destination SurfaceRect variables; other 28 drawing pairs pass two MakeSurfaceRect returned values directly.
Native reusable Rect local source must be the second field after destination inside the normal C++ RenderWork object to preserve original VC7.1 stack offsets.
Writing 0 - settingsSlideOffset preserves the original xor/sub integer expression in place of the different instruction coding for unary minus.
The original compiler emits an eight-DWORD switch table at 0x0075D240 through 0x0075D25F, explicitly owned by this function.
